definitions.explanation: Color that is not even across a surface, darker in some places and lighter in others: in dyed cloth, paint, hair dye, makeup or a photo print.

examples.japanese: ⟦ペンキ→ペンキ：00342_penki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{薄|うす}く→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}ったら→塗る：01174_nuru⟧{色|いろ}むら⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I put the paint on too thinly and it came out patchy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{染|そ}める→染める：04253_someru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{色|いろ}むら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{美容院|びよういん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ことにした。
examples.english: Dyeing my own hair tends to leave it uneven, so I decided to go to a salon.

notes:
FORMS:
From ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ + むら (unevenness), which also appears alone and in other compounds. Also written {色|いろ}ムラ, especially in product descriptions and cosmetics ads.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色|いろ}むら⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ / ⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to be / come out uneven in color
- {色|いろ}むら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to end up blotchy
- {色|いろ}むら⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent uneven color

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{色落|いろお}ち→色落ち：20012_iroochi⟧: fading, color coming out in the wash
- ⟦{色移|いろうつ}り→色移り：34076_iroutsuri⟧: dye from one item staining another

cross_references.label: dye from one item staining another
